blockingFindings.title: Diagnostic coverage never exercises explicit provider override failure state
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires unresolved-provider diagnostics to include the explicit provider override state, but the only R4 failure test calls Agent.call without a provider override. A diagnostic implementation could omit or mishandle the supplied explicit override value/state and still pass this test suite.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add or adjust a spec-local Agent.call rejection test that supplies an explicit unresolved provider override, then asserts the diagnostic reports that explicit override state without leaking sensitive details.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a concrete acceptance requirement with no executable coverage for the explicit-override failure path.
